name: @mixdog/desktop
description: Mixdog desktop host for Windows, macOS, and Linux

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test:renderer: node scripts/memory-guard.mjs --cap-mb=1200 --min-free-mb=2048 --sample-ms=200 --label=renderer.dom -- node --max-old-space-size=1536 --import ./scripts/test-env.mjs --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/renderer/renderer.dom.test.mjs && node scripts/memory-guard.mjs --cap-mb=1200 --min-free-mb=2048 --sample-ms=200 --label=renderer.suites -- node --max-old-space-size=1536 --import ./scripts/test-env.mjs --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/renderer/renderer.test.mjs src/renderer/sidebar-drawer-frame.test.mjs src/renderer/sidebar-usage-tone.test.mjs src/renderer/renderer-dom-test-harness.test.mjs src/renderer/usage-dashboard-store.dom.test.mjs src/renderer/session-sidebar.dom.test.mjs src/renderer/SourceControlDock.dom.test.mjs src/renderer/PullRequestsPane.dom.test.mjs src/renderer/utility-dock-readiness.dom.test.mjs src/renderer/UtilityDock.tabs.dom.test.mjs src/renderer/pane-layout.test.mjs scripts/bounded-assert.test.mjs scripts/memory-guard.test.mjs src/main/git-cli.test.mjs src/main/developer-workflow.test.mjs src/main/workspace-search.test.mjs src/main/workspace-config.test.mjs src/main/engine-host.test.mjs src/main/utility-engine-host.test.mjs src/main/desktop-diagnostics.test.mjs src/main/language-server-manager.test.mjs
scripts.test:settings: node --max-old-space-size=1024 --import ./scripts/test-env.mjs --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/main/settings-store.test.mjs src/main/agent-awake.test.mjs src/renderer/settings/SettingsView.test.mjs src/renderer/SchedulesView.test.mjs src/renderer/WebhooksView.test.mjs src/renderer/sidebar-reference-cache.test.mjs src/renderer/sidebar-reference-panels.dom.test.mjs
scripts.test:packaging: node --import tsx --test src/main/packaging.test.mjs src/main/window-state.test.mjs src/main/live-layout-probe.test.mjs src/main/viewport-guard.test.mjs
scripts.verify:renderer: npm run test:renderer && node src/renderer/verify-renderer.mjs && npm run typecheck:renderer
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && npm run brand:win && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:win:arm64: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=arm64 && npm run brand:win && electron-builder --win --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --linux
